about:
Mothership Workshop operates from Fargo, North Dakota, as the art and furniture design studio of Josh Zeis and Mike Nelson. The two longtime friends, both classically trained artists, founded the studio to design, build, and create work across disciplines with a specialization in concrete. Their collaboration began from a shared artistic background and a desire to tackle new ideas through an experimental approach to construction.

The studio produces a wide range of concrete pieces, including countertops, full kitchen islands, custom sinks, outdoor kitchen areas, fire tables, seating, furniture such as tables and desks, wall panels, 3-D tiles, planters, sculptural works, corporate sculptures, museum pieces, architectural reproductions, mold making, and lighting fixtures. Each piece is hand-built using casting, carving, and mold-making techniques, with an emphasis on one-of-a-kind, heirloom-quality results.

Mothership Workshop serves residential clients seeking custom concrete furniture and accents, commercial businesses needing reception desks, conference tables, and accent walls, as well as corporate and institutional clients commissioning sculptures and museum-quality reproductions. Past work includes museum pieces with carved concrete fossils and organic textures, and corporate sculptures for public spaces.

The founders emphasize experimentation and an artistic approach to construction, valuing the care and intent of fine art in every functional piece. This philosophy drives their willingness to tackle complex design challenges and produce durable, hand-built objects meant to last generations.
